# llm-wiki CLI Reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-cli-reference.py from the argparse tree. Do not edit by hand. -->

`llm-wiki` is the deterministic control-plane CLI. Command specs call it first
wherever a deterministic subcommand exists and reserve agent work for the
semantic passes the CLI cannot judge. This file lists every namespace,
subcommand and flag exactly as the parser defines them.

Locate the CLI through the installed plugin root (`bin/llm-wiki`); in a source
checkout use `scripts/llm-wiki`. Never assume a global install. Every
`llm-wiki <namespace> <subcommand>` named in a command spec must appear below.

Conventions shared by most namespaces: `--local` targets `.wiki/` in the
current directory, `--wiki <slug>` names a wiki in the hub registry, `--hub`
overrides hub resolution, `--private` / `--public` switch between a topic and
its `-PRIVATE` sibling, and a positional or `--path` wiki root bypasses
resolution. `--json` prints a machine-readable report where offered. Flags
listed under a namespace go before its subcommand (`archive --hub H list`);
`archive`, `schema`, `identity` and `specialist` accept them after it too.

Namespaces: `lint`, `archive`, `schema`, `identity`, `hub`, `registry`, `retract`, `specialist`, `adapter`, `checkpoint`, `privacy`, `links`, `dataset`, `rules`, `engine`, `pin`, `freshness`, `project`, `adopt`, `source`.

## `llm-wiki lint`

Deterministic checks (no LLM) on a wiki root given by path, --local or --wiki.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[path]` | Wiki root path to lint. |
| `--fix` | Apply unambiguous structural fixes. |
| `--preflight, --plan` | Plan the --fix writes and write nothing. |
| `--fix-only CLASS[,CLASS]` | Apply only these fix classes (quarantine, placement, frontmatter, index, create, registry, gitignore, log); implies --fix. |
| `--no-quarantine` | Leave unexpected files in place. |
| `--no-log` | Do not append to log.md. |
| `--refuse-on CLASS[,CLASS]` | Exit 2, writing nothing, if these classes would act. |
| `--local` | Lint .wiki/ in the current directory. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Named wiki from the hub registry. |
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path for --wiki resolution. |
| `--private` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the private sibling <slug>-PRIVATE. (not with --public) |
| `--public` | Resolve --wiki <slug>-PRIVATE to the public sibling <slug>. (not with --private) |
| `--include-archived` | Allow linting an explicitly targeted archived wiki. |
| `--json` | Print a machine-readable JSON report. |
| `--strict-engine` | Make a declared/running engine mismatch critical, not a warning. |
| `--fail-on {critical,warning,suggestion}` | Lowest severity that exits non-zero (default: suggestion; none for --preflight). |
| `--github-annotations` | Print GitHub annotations after the report. |
| `--max-warnings N` | Exit 1 above N warnings. |
| `--profile NAME[,NAME]` | Opt-in checks: citations, datasets. |
| `--all` | Lint every root of the hub. |
| `--include-nested-wiki` | With --all, add topics/*/.wiki. |
| `--skip-private` | With --all, skip -PRIVATE roots. |
| `--report-dir DIR` | With --all, write reports to DIR. |

## `llm-wiki archive`

Move whole topic wikis between topics/<slug> and topics/.archive/<slug>, updating wikis.json so archived topics stay out of default context.

Options and arguments given before the subcommand:

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path for archive operations. |
| `--private` | Resolve topic slugs to private siblings ending in -PRIVATE. (not with --public) |
| `--public` | Normalize slugs ending in -PRIVATE to public siblings. (not with --private) |

Subcommands: `list`, `topic`, `restore`.

### `llm-wiki archive list`

List active and archived topics.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--archived` | Show archived topics in addition to active topics. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki archive topic`

Archive an active topic wiki.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `slug` | Topic slug to archive. |
| `--reason REASON` | Optional archive reason. |
| `--require-cwd-hub` | Refuse unless the selected hub is the hub enclosing the current directory. |

### `llm-wiki archive restore`

Restore an archived topic wiki.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `slug` | Topic slug to restore. |
| `--require-cwd-hub` | Refuse unless the selected hub is the hub enclosing the current directory. |

## `llm-wiki identity`

A wiki's identity is declared as wiki_id in its config.md and a hub's as hub_id in its wikis.json; both are independent of where the root currently lives. Registry entries that carry the same id can be verified on resolution instead of trusted. assign never replaces a declared id; fork is the explicit way to re-identify an independent copy.

Options and arguments given before the subcommand:

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--local` | Target .wiki/ in the current directory. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Named wiki from the hub registry. |
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path for --wiki resolution. |
| `--private` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the private sibling <slug>-PRIVATE. (not with --public) |
| `--public` | Resolve --wiki <slug>-PRIVATE to the public sibling <slug>. (not with --private) |
| `--include-archived` | Allow identity operations on an explicitly targeted archived wiki. |

Subcommands: `status`, `assign`, `fork`.

### `llm-wiki identity status`

Print the declared wiki id (or, with --hub, the hub id and each topic's).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print a JSON report. |
| `[path]` | Wiki root path. |
| `--local` | Target .wiki/ in the current directory. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Named wiki from the hub registry. |
| `--hub HUB` | Target the hub itself (path optional: the resolved hub); with --wiki, override the hub path. |
| `--private` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to <slug>-PRIVATE. |
| `--public` | Resolve --wiki <slug>-PRIVATE to <slug>. |
| `--include-archived` | Allow targeting an archived wiki. |

### `llm-wiki identity assign`

Declare a wiki id in config.md (or, with --hub, a hub id) if there is none.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[path]` | Wiki root path. |
| `--local` | Target .wiki/ in the current directory. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Named wiki from the hub registry. |
| `--hub HUB` | Target the hub itself (path optional: the resolved hub); with --wiki, override the hub path. |
| `--private` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to <slug>-PRIVATE. |
| `--public` | Resolve --wiki <slug>-PRIVATE to <slug>. |
| `--include-archived` | Allow targeting an archived wiki. |
| `--id ID` | Use this id instead of generating one. |
| `--dry-run` | Report what would happen without writing. |

### `llm-wiki identity fork`

Replace a declared id with a new one and record the old one (independent copies).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[path]` | Wiki root path. |
| `--local` | Target .wiki/ in the current directory. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Named wiki from the hub registry. |
| `--hub HUB` | Target the hub itself (path optional: the resolved hub); with --wiki, override the hub path. |
| `--private` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to <slug>-PRIVATE. |
| `--public` | Resolve --wiki <slug>-PRIVATE to <slug>. |
| `--include-archived` | Allow targeting an archived wiki. |
| `--id ID` | Use this new id instead of generating one. |
| `--dry-run` | Report what would happen without writing. |

## `llm-wiki hub`

Check or refresh the hub index, check registry paths, and show which hub is selected.

Subcommands: `index`, `registry`, `where`.

### `llm-wiki hub index`

Compare the topic table and statistics of HUB/_index.md with wikis.json. --check (the default) exits 1 when they differ; --write refreshes only the generated table and counts, keeping curated sections, extra columns, the BOM and the newline style; --stats prints the registry counts and its mismatch with topics/ and writes nothing.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--check` | Report drift; exit 1 when out of date (default). (not with --write or --stats) |
| `--write` | Refresh the generated table and counts. (not with --check or --stats) |
| `--stats` | Count active, archived and private topics, topic directories without a registry entry and entries without a directory, and show the index date; exit 0. (not with --check or --write) |
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path. |
| `--require-cwd-hub` | Refuse unless the selected hub is the hub enclosing the current directory. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki hub registry`

Read-only checks of the hub registry and its per-machine overlay wikis.local.json.

Subcommands: `check`.

#### `llm-wiki hub registry check`

Report each tracked wikis.json path, whether it is portable (<HUB>-relative, no drive, absolute, ~ or escaping .. path), and the wikis.local.json path this machine uses instead. --portable exits 1 on a path that is not portable or an overlay git does not ignore.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--portable` | Exit 1 unless every tracked path is portable and wikis.local.json is ignored. |
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki hub where`

Hub precedence: --hub, then LLM_WIKI_HUB, then the hub enclosing the current directory when config.json sets "hub_discovery": "cwd", then hub_path. Shows the git branch, ahead/behind and dirty state of each hub.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

## `llm-wiki registry`

Machine-local registry of hubs and wikis keyed on their stable ids (~/.config/llm-wiki/registry.json). It lists the roots this machine knows, keeps unavailable ones registered, and finds the current path of an id; it never replaces hub_path, LLM_WIKI_HUB, --hub or cwd discovery, and a root's own id stays authoritative. Exit 0 success, 1 a refusal (undeclared id, duplicate alias, ambiguity, nothing available), 2 unusable input (corrupt registry file, not a root, unknown id, lock held).

Subcommands: `add`, `list`, `refresh`, `remove`, `locate`.

### `llm-wiki registry add`

<path> is a hub (wikis.json) or a wiki (config.md; for a wiki nested in a directory, pass its .wiki path). The root must declare an id (llm-wiki identity assign [--hub]); --assign assigns one, the only write into a root this namespace does. The same id at another path is a second replica (added, with a notice); the same id at the same path is a no-op.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `path` | Hub or wiki root to register. |
| `--alias ALIAS` | A unique name for this entry (surrounding whitespace is stripped). |
| `--assign` | Assign an id to a root that declares none. |

### `llm-wiki registry list`

Read-only. Status: available (path exists and declares the registered id), unavailable (path missing or unreadable, or its wikis.json / config.md cannot be read; the entry stays), mismatch (the path declares another id; 'forked -> <id>' when it was forked from the registered one), undeclared (path exists, no id).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki registry refresh`

Writes only last_seen, only on available entries, and only when it changes.

_No arguments._

### `llm-wiki registry remove`

Removes exactly one entry. An id with several replicas, or a path shared by several entries, exits 1 and lists them; name the path to pick one. Nothing inside the root is touched.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` | An id, an alias or a registered path. |

### `llm-wiki registry locate`

Read-only. Exactly one available replica: its path, exit 0. None available: exit 1 with the last known paths and statuses. Several available: exit 1 'ambiguous: N replicas of <id>'; --all lists them and exits 0. An alias selects its own entry. Unknown id or alias: exit 2.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `target` | An id (hb-... / wk-...) or an alias. |
| `--all` | List every available replica instead of failing on several. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

## `llm-wiki retract`

Find a value and common encoded forms without placing the value in command arguments. Dry-run is the default; pass --apply to rewrite matched text, rename matched paths, and verify the selected local scope.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[path]` | Wiki root path to scan. |
| `--stdin` | Read the value from standard input instead of a hidden prompt; one trailing newline (LF or CRLF) is dropped, as echo and printf add one. |
| `--apply` | Apply changes and verify again. |
| `--local` | Target .wiki/ in the current directory. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Target a named wiki, including an archived wiki. |
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path resolution. |
| `--everywhere` | Scan the hub, registered wiki roots, archives, sessions, and current .wiki/. |
| `--variants {exact,common}` | Match exact bytes only or also common JSON, URL, base64, and hex forms. (default: common) |
| `--delete-binary-matches` | Delete whole binary files containing a match; otherwise report them as unresolved. |
| `--remove-from-logs` | Remove complete matching entries from log.md files instead of replacing the selected value inside those entries. |
| `--allow-short` | Accept a value shorter than 8 bytes. Short values match unrelated content throughout the scope; combine with --variants exact. Encoded forms shorter than 12 characters are never matched. |
| `--max-file-bytes N` | Skip files larger than N bytes and report each as an error (the result is then incomplete). 0, the default, scans files of any size; files are read in chunks. |
| `--json` | Print a machine-readable report. |

## `llm-wiki adapter`

Manage the machine-local private-adapter registry. Adapter code and credentials stay outside the wiki; successful runs return verified artifacts but never import them automatically.

Subcommands: `add`, `list`, `show`, `route`, `doctor`, `run`, `remove`.

### `llm-wiki adapter add`

Register an adapter from an existing local checkout.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `path` | Local adapter root containing .llm-wiki-adapter.json. |
| `--read-root READ_ROOT` | Allowed adapter input root; repeatable. |
| `--write-root WRITE_ROOT` | Allowed adapter output root; repeatable. |
| `--env ENV` | Environment variable name to pass without storing its value; repeatable. |
| `--remote-resource REMOTE_RESOURCE` | Exact remote resource identifier allowed for this adapter; repeatable. |
| `--replace` | Replace an existing registration with the same id. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki adapter list`

List registered adapters.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki adapter show`

Show one registration.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `adapter_id` | Registered adapter id. |
| `--json` | Print JSON (the default output format). |

### `llm-wiki adapter route`

Match an intent and resource against registered adapter routes.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--intent INTENT` | Lowercase requested-effect token. (required) |
| `--resource RESOURCE` | External resource URL to classify. (required) |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki adapter doctor`

Validate a registration and perform the describe handshake.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `adapter_id` | Registered adapter id. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Handshake timeout in seconds. (default: 30) |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki adapter run`

Execute a registered operation from a JSON request.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `adapter_id` | Registered adapter id. |
| `--request REQUEST` | Absolute path to the v1 request JSON. (required) |
| `--response RESPONSE` | Optional path where the validated response receipt is copied. |
| `--timeout TIMEOUT` | Execution timeout in seconds. (default: 3600) |
| `--approve-remote-write PLAN_SHA256` | Explicitly approve a remote-write operation for this exact plan hash. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki adapter remove`

Remove a local registration.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `adapter_id` | Registered adapter id. |
| `--yes` | Confirm removal. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

## `llm-wiki checkpoint`

Deterministically validate, hash, privacy-scan, seal, and verify a Project Knowledge Checkpoint generated by the agentic wiki workflow.

Subcommands: `seal`, `verify`.

### `llm-wiki checkpoint seal`

Finalize hashes and run the mandatory privacy scan.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `path` | Checkpoint bundle directory. |
| `--audience {private,public,team}` | Declared recipient boundary for source-access validation. (required) |
| `--allow-finding ALLOW_FINDING` | Explicitly acknowledge one exact finding ID; repeatable. |
| `--allowlist FILE` | Allow file shared with `privacy scan`; needs --override-reason. |
| `--allow-source ALLOW_SOURCE` | Explicitly retain one exact wiki:path input above the audience; repeatable. |
| `--override-reason OVERRIDE_REASON` | One-line reason required for any source or finding override. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki checkpoint verify`

Recheck bundle structure, hashes, and privacy attestation.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `path` | Checkpoint bundle directory. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

## `llm-wiki privacy`

Privacy scanning with the pattern pack `checkpoint seal` uses.

Subcommands: `scan`.

### `llm-wiki privacy scan`

Scan .md, .json, .html, .txt, .yaml, .yml and .toml files; excerpts never show the match. Exit 0 clean, 1 findings at or above --fail-on, 2 usage error.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[path]` | Root directory to scan. |
| `--local` | Scan ./.wiki. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Scan a named wiki. |
| `--hub HUB` | Hub path; alone, scan the hub itself. |
| `--scope {tracked,worktree}` | Tracked files or the whole tree (default: tracked inside a work tree). |
| `--patterns FILE` | Extra JSON pack of {id, kind, regex, severity, description}; repeatable. |
| `--allowlist FILE` | Allow file shared with `checkpoint seal`: `privacy-<id>` or `path::kind::match` regex lines. |
| `--fail-on {warning,critical}` | Lowest severity that exits 1. (default: critical) |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |
| `--show-allowed` | List allowed findings too. |
| `--check {tracked-private,cross-boundary}` | Run only this check (critical): tracked paths under *-PRIVATE/, or references into a -PRIVATE sibling. Default: content scan + cross-boundary. |
| `--anchors ANCHORS` | Comma-separated basenames the check tolerates. (default: ) |

| `--json` | Print JSON. |

## `llm-wiki pin`

Show, set, resolve and verify the engine pin in config.md. A hub may declare the pin once in HUB/config.md; topics that declare none inherit it.

Subcommands: `status`, `set`, `resolve`, `verify`.

### `llm-wiki pin status`

Show the declared pin and its verdict; for a hub, also every active topic.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--path PATH` | Show the wiki root at this path. |
| `--local` | Show ./.wiki in the current directory. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Named wiki from the hub registry. |
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path for --wiki resolution. |
| `--private` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the private sibling <slug>-PRIVATE. (not with --public) |
| `--public` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the public sibling without -PRIVATE. (not with --private) |
| `--include-archived` | Allow --wiki to resolve an archived topic. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki pin set`

Write the engine pin. A tag or version pins the release (knowmade_version / llm_wiki_version); a commit SHA pins knowmade_checker_sha / llm_wiki_checker_sha. Writing one form of a pin removes the other. The hub's config.md is created when missing; newline style and BOM are kept.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--knowmade KNOWMADE` | Knowmade release tag, version or commit SHA. |
| `--upstream UPSTREAM` | Upstream llm-wiki release tag, version or commit SHA. |
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path. |
| `--path PATH` | Write this wiki root's existing config.md instead of the hub's. |
| `--write-topics` | Also write the pin into every active topic's config.md under the hub's topics/. |
| `--require-cwd-hub` | Refuse unless the selected hub is the hub enclosing the current directory. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki pin resolve`

Print the commit a tag names.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `tag` | Tag to resolve, for example v0.5.1.25.1. |
| `--repo REPO` | Git clone to resolve in (default: the engine's own checkout). |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki pin verify`

Exit 2 unless the running engine is the pinned one (the CI step).

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--engine` | Verify the running engine against the declared (or inherited) pin. (required) |
| `--path PATH` | Verify the wiki root at this path. |
| `--local` | Verify ./.wiki in the current directory. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Named wiki from the hub registry. |
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path for --wiki resolution. |
| `--private` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the private sibling <slug>-PRIVATE. (not with --public) |
| `--public` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the public sibling without -PRIVATE. (not with --private) |
| `--include-archived` | Allow --wiki to resolve an archived topic. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

## `llm-wiki freshness`

List compiled articles due for refresh under the configured freshness windows.

Subcommands: `report`, `score`.

### `llm-wiki freshness report`

Read-only. Windows come from freshness_hot_days, freshness_warm_days and freshness_cold_days in config.md (a topic inherits HUB/config.md's), default 30/180/365. Articles with freshness: snapshot are left out unless --include-snapshots. Exit 0, or 2 when the root is missing or is a hub.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--path PATH` | Report on the wiki root at this path. |
| `--local` | Report on ./.wiki in the current directory. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Named wiki from the hub registry. |
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path for --wiki resolution. |
| `--private` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the private sibling <slug>-PRIVATE. (not with --public) |
| `--public` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the public sibling without -PRIVATE. (not with --private) |
| `--include-archived` | Allow --wiki to resolve an archived topic. |
| `--due N` | List articles with fewer than N days left in their window (default 0: already stale). |
| `--include-snapshots` | Also list freshness: snapshot articles. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

### `llm-wiki freshness score`

Read-only. librarian.md's four 0-25 dimensions with volatility half-lives (hot 30, warm 90, cold 365 days); compiled-from: conversation rebased on two. Threshold from freshness_threshold in config.md (a topic inherits HUB/config.md's), default 70. Exit 0, or 2 when the root is missing or is a hub.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--path PATH` | Score the wiki root at this path. |
| `--local` | Score ./.wiki in the current directory. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Named wiki from the hub registry. |
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path for --wiki resolution. |
| `--private` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the private sibling <slug>-PRIVATE. (not with --public) |
| `--public` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the public sibling without -PRIVATE. (not with --private) |
| `--include-archived` | Allow --wiki to resolve an archived topic. |
| `--threshold N` | Override freshness_threshold (0-100). |
| `--all` | List every article, not only those below the threshold. |
| `--include-snapshots` | Also list freshness: snapshot articles. |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

## `llm-wiki project`

Deterministic project-folder maintenance under output/projects/.

Subcommands: `migrate-why`.

### `llm-wiki project migrate-why`

Lossless C8c migration: title and goal from the frontmatter, derived Members sections dropped, every other section kept in order. Skips folders that have WHY.md; refuses a manifest with nothing to preserve. Exit 0, or 2 when the root is missing or is a hub.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[path]` | Wiki root path. |
| `--local` | Use ./.wiki in the current directory. |
| `--wiki WIKI` | Named wiki from the hub registry. |
| `--hub HUB` | Override hub path for --wiki resolution. |
| `--private` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the private sibling <slug>-PRIVATE. (not with --public) |
| `--public` | Resolve --wiki <slug> to the public sibling without -PRIVATE. (not with --private) |
| `--include-archived` | Allow --wiki to resolve an archived topic. |
| `--dry-run` | Preview only (the default). (not with --apply) |
| `--apply` | Write WHY.md, delete _project.md, log once. (not with --dry-run) |
| `--json` | Print JSON. |

## `llm-wiki adopt`

Scan, apply, resume, and verify deterministic brownfield adoption.

Subcommands: `scan`, `apply`, `status`, `claim`, `complete`, `release`, `fail`, `sweep`, `repair`, `verify`.

### `llm-wiki adopt scan`

Inventory a brownfield project without writing.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[project_root]` | Existing project/research directory. (default: .) |
| `--wiki-root WIKI_ROOT` | Wiki root to initialize; defaults to <project>/.wiki. |
| `--title TITLE` | Wiki title; defaults to the project directory name. |
| `--mode {reference,copy,move}` | (default: reference) |
| `--yes` | Required confirmation for move apply. |
| `--batch-id BATCH_ID` | Explicit batch id; default is date + project slug + path hash. |
| `--exclude EXCLUDE` | Glob relative to project root; repeatable. |
| `--subtree SUBTREE` | Directory relative to the project root; repeatable. Scan only these subtrees (paths and item ids stay project-relative). With --apply and an existing --batch-id, add the new rows to that batch. |
| `--max-files MAX_FILES` | (default: 10000) |
| `--small-data-limit SMALL_DATA_LIMIT` | Bytes; larger CSV/JSON/XML/YAML becomes dataset-class. (default: 20971520) |
| `--hash-limit HASH_LIMIT` | Bytes; larger files are not hashed during planning. (default: 67108864) |
| `--json` | Emit machine-readable plan/summary. |
| `--no-gitignore` | With --apply, do not append the wiki directory to the project's .gitignore. |

### `llm-wiki adopt apply`

Initialize .wiki and write an adoption batch.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `[project_root]` | Existing project/research directory. (default: .) |
| `--wiki-root WIKI_ROOT` | Wiki root to initialize; defaults to <project>/.wiki. |
| `--title TITLE` | Wiki title; defaults to the project directory name. |
| `--mode {reference,copy,move}` | (default: reference) |
| `--yes` | Required confirmation for move apply. |
| `--batch-id BATCH_ID` | Explicit batch id; default is date + project slug + path hash. |
| `--exclude EXCLUDE` | Glob relative to project root; repeatable. |
| `--subtree SUBTREE` | Directory relative to the project root; repeatable. Scan only these subtrees (paths and item ids stay project-relative). With --apply and an existing --batch-id, add the new rows to that batch. |
| `--max-files MAX_FILES` | (default: 10000) |
| `--small-data-limit SMALL_DATA_LIMIT` | Bytes; larger CSV/JSON/XML/YAML becomes dataset-class. (default: 20971520) |
| `--hash-limit HASH_LIMIT` | Bytes; larger files are not hashed during planning. (default: 67108864) |
| `--json` | Emit machine-readable plan/summary. |
| `--no-gitignore` | With --apply, do not append the wiki directory to the project's .gitignore. |

### `llm-wiki adopt status`

Show adoption batch state.

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `batch` | Batch directory, or batch id with --wiki-root. |
| `--wiki-root WIKI_ROOT` | Wiki root when batch is supplied by id; also overrides the root recorded in state.json. |

## `llm-wiki source`

Receive, extract, retain, resolve and verify source originals for one wiki.

Subcommands: `receive`, `extract`, `attach-derived`, `decide`, `verify`, `resolve`, `paths`, `import-pointer`, `map`.

### `llm-wiki source receive`

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `source` | - |
| `--quarantine-reason QUARANTINE_REASON` | - |
| `--canonical-url CANONICAL_URL` | Record this http(s) URL as the source's canonical URL (for a file captured from the web earlier). |
| `--retrieved-at RETRIEVED_AT` | ISO 8601 time the bytes were retrieved; recorded with --canonical-url. |
| `--note NOTE` | Free-text note recorded with the source. |
| `--alias PATH` | Another name (typically a repository path) of the same bytes; repeatable. |
| `--path PATH` | Wiki root; defaults to normal wiki resolution. |
| `--local` | - |
| `--wiki WIKI` | - |
| `--hub HUB` | - |

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `source_id` | - |
| `--path PATH` | Wiki root; defaults to normal wiki resolution. |
| `--local` | - |
| `--wiki WIKI` | - |
| `--hub HUB` | - |

| Argument | Meaning |

| `--hub HUB` | - |

| Argument | Meaning |

| `--wiki WIKI` | - |
| `--hub HUB` | - |

| `--wiki WIKI` | - |
| `--hub HUB` | - |
